newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith slips, profit forecasts raised.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith slips, profit forecasts raised.

text.p: Shares in W H Smith Group Plc slipped on Wednesday after the company made a pretax loss of 194.7 million stg, despite small revisions to analysts' forecasts for next year's earnings.
By 1200 GMT, the shares were down 5-1/2p at 510p after being up 1-1/2p at 517p immediately after the results.
"The costs taken out of the business and the refocusing give a platform for increased productivity," said Roy Maconochie, stores analyst at Henderson Crosthwaite.
"Plus there are benefits from the rationalisation of the supplier arrangements."
